posts.title: Varlink observability
posts.description: A few days ago systemd gained tools which allow you to monitor Varlink traffic. A new Varlink service ( io.systemd.VarlinkMonitor ) allows you to set up a ring buffer which will get filled with packets containing the traffic which matches the filters you provide. posts.title: Announcing Sovereign Tech Agency Investment in Flatpak
posts.description: Together with Modal , I’m happy to announce that the Sovereign Tech Agency is investing nearly €510k into Flatpak development. The focus is on closing gaps in Flatpak’s sandboxing story: new portals for audio, networking, VPNs, and spell checking, plus infrastructure work on entitlements and intents.
